title: The Missing Diplomat: From Stormwind to Alcaz
summary: A Classic investigation identifies Varian Wrynn and Private Hendel; a separate patch 2.3 continuation uncovers a wreck, a prisoner’s manacles and signs of a powerful but unnamed Alliance patron.
opening: A sealed letter leaves Stormwind Keep and passes through trusted hands. The trail runs from Duskwood farms to the Wetlands harbor, then across the sea to Theramore. The original Classic chain finds a suspect but not the missing king. A later patch 2.3 addition returns to the question by way of a Defias shipwreck and the rune-marked island of Alcaz.

chapters.title: A quiet commission
chapters.body: Thomas and DeLavey set an investigation in motion through the bishop’s private contacts.

chapters.title: A docket in Duskwood
chapters.body: Elling and Backus trace Defias activity from Stormwind to the papers at Addle’s Stead.

chapters.title: The missing king
chapters.body: Slim names Varian and Hendel; the Classic chain ends with Hendel in custody and the king still absent.

chapters.title: Cargo beneath the marsh
chapters.body: The patch 2.3 continuation is a separately sourced addition that turns a wreck and enchanted manacles into new evidence.

chapters.title: The island and the patron
chapters.body: Jaina’s aerial survey and report to Bolvar narrow the suspicion but leave the patron and Varian’s fate unknown.

reviewNote: Complete 24-scene illustrated research story with source-linked event, claim and citation records; separate Classic and patch 2.3 boundaries; original interpretive character and location art; Stormwind, Duskwood, Wetlands, Theramore, Dreadmurk and Alcaz scenes; and transcript-matched voice-over. StoryTour placement after the Outland Cipher is editorial because this story’s final playable segment was added in patch 2.3; the original Classic chain remains an earlier subperiod. At the story boundary Varian remains missing and the patron is unnamed. Do not conflate either chain with The Great Masquerade, the later Proof of Treachery, comics, Varian’s rescue, or an Onyxia plot. Human source review, original-client comparison, game-area resemblance review and audio audition remain open. Content remains research and never implies exact dates, routes, or co-presence.
